term: operation through a form, directed to an end (OperatesThrough x f o, DirectedTo o e)
definition: OperatesThrough x f o: o is an operation of x of which the form f (natural or intelligible) is the principle (forma est principium operationis). DirectedTo o e: the operation o is directed to the end e (omne agens agit propter finem), which need not be conscious (DEF-INTENTIO-AS-TENDING). Neither is inclination (InclinedTo, DEF-NATURAL-APPETITE-FORM-INCLINATION); the open premise STMT-END-DIRECTED-OPERATION-IS-INCLINATION relates them. Example: fire heating through its form, toward its proper place or effect. In Lean parameters B -> F -> O -> Prop and O -> E -> Prop.
